evidence.excerpt: Introducing Financial Datasets YC S26! Got an AI Agent that needs to connect to the stock market? Financial Datasets is building the #1 very best way to do this. When I first met Virat I assumed his product was basically just for trading bots but it turns out there are many, many other types of agents that need market and corporate data.
